# Pure Cycle Corporation Announces Dates for Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Release and Presentation


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_7c7f80868d5ceffbebc6a21745a3bcb1/purecyclewater/news/2026-11-10_Pure_Cycle_Corporation_Announces_Dates_for_Fiscal__162.pdf) November 10, 2026 8:00am EST


DENVER, Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Pure Cycle Corporation (NASDAQ Capital Market: PCYO) will release financial results for the fiscal year ended August 31, 2026, on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, after the market closes, and will hold an earnings presentation on Thursday, November 19, 2026, to discuss the results. To ask questions and view the slide presentation, please register and join the event using the event link below.


**Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings Presentation**


When: 8:30 a.m. Eastern (6:30 a.m. Mountain) on Thursday, November 19, 2026


Event link:[https://www.purecyclewater.com/YE2026](https://www.purecyclewater.com/YE2026)


Call-in number: 872-240-8702 (access code: 735 663 050#)


Replay:[https://www.purecyclewater.com/investors/news-events/ir-calendar](https://www.purecyclewater.com/investors/news-events/ir-calendar)


**About Pure Cycle Corporation**


Pure Cycle continues to grow and strengthen its operations, grow its balance sheet, and drive recurring revenues. We operate in three distinct business segments, each of which complements the others. At our core, we are a wholesale water and wastewater service provider. In 2017, we launched our land development segment, which develops master planned communities on land we own and to which we provide water and wastewater services. In 2021, we began renting single-family homes that we built at Sky Ranch.


Additional information, including our recent press releases and SEC filings, is available at[www.purecyclewater.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gWYLlLr_tfTPqYqkhlYzuK1w32dQGjTYID4xRosg0h5kcN7pohVoXnOWRCCacr4-d-MshJzdISk17RinSrNCZepw_fvAFvUz3JNwjSYxfi0=) , or you may contact our President and Chief Executive Officer, Mark W. Harding, or our Chief Financial Officer, Marc Spezialy, at 303-292-3456 or[info@purecyclewater.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=goFcAr5nphtxi0EpP064Ep8rM8pKe_xazCkrd3OUThdHwNc-obSMf8obzXvJ53KcdGBinqI-hBL0geSNsJuDI6hzGouzW8_eC8JUxTswE-c=) .
